title: Reservation Governing-Scope Capacity Admission Evaluation
classification: pure synchronous governing-scope capacity admission policy evaluation
decomposition: One pure synchronous admission-rule responsibility. FOOD-007E supplies the independent canonical reservation-demand/source-selection context; FOOD-007T supplies governing-scope demand-adjusted recorded-capacity evidence. FOOD-007U strictly correlates both before assigning admission meaning. Persistence, mutation, concurrency control and acceptance remain downstream.
purpose: Strictly validate and correlate canonical FOOD-007E reservation demand/source-selection context with canonical FOOD-007T governing-scope demand recorded-capacity arithmetic, then evaluate whether every demanded SKU and the selected fulfillment slot satisfy capacity admission rule version 1.

selectionRequest.meaning: Independent canonical reservation request demand, reservation-request identity, fulfillment-intent identity, exact demanded SKU order, selected SKU revisions and selected fulfillment-slot identity/revision.

arithmetic.meaning: Canonical governing-scope signed demand-adjusted recorded-capacity evidence that must correlate exactly with the supplied FOOD-007E reservation demand and selected revisions.

semanticRule.admissible: Every SKU recordedDemandAdjustedCapacityDelta is greater than or equal to zero AND the slot recordedDemandAdjustedCapacityDelta is greater than or equal to zero.
semanticRule.insufficient-capacity: At least one SKU or the slot has recordedDemandAdjustedCapacityDelta less than zero.
semanticRule.invalid: The supplied FOOD-007T evidence is structurally invalid, numerically invalid, internally inconsistent or otherwise noncanonical.

policy.aggregateRule: all SKUs and the slot must be individually admissible

output.ownership: Detached and deeply frozen root, identity references, SKU-admission array, every SKU-admission entry and nested SKU identity, and slot-admission value.
output.ordering: Preserve canonical FOOD-007T SKU order exactly. Never sort, search-and-reorder or repair.

algorithm: Capture both caller-supplied inputs before trusted semantic reads. Do not invoke caller accessors or inherited iteration hooks.

Strictly validate the FOOD-007E selectionRequest using its canonical exact-root and nested structural contracts, including canonical reservation request, fulfillment intent, demanded SKU order, selected SKU revisions and selected fulfillment slot.
Strictly validate the FOOD-007T arithmetic root using the exact canonical FOOD-007T field set.
Require FOOD-007T reservationRequest id/version to equal FOOD-007E request id/version exactly.
Require FOOD-007T fulfillmentIntent id/version to equal FOOD-007E fulfillmentIntent id/version exactly.
Require selectionRequest.request.capacityRequirements length, selectionRequest.skuSelections length and FOOD-007T skuArithmetic length to be exactly equal.
Correlate SKUs strictly by canonical demand-order index. Never sort, search-and-reorder or repair.
At every SKU index require request demand SKU id/version, selected SKU id/version and FOOD-007T arithmetic SKU id/version to be identical.
At every SKU index require FOOD-007E selected revision to equal FOOD-007T governingRevision exactly.
At every SKU index require FOOD-007T demandQuantity to equal the canonical FOOD-007E request demand quantity exactly.
Require the FOOD-007E selected slot and FOOD-007T slot arithmetic to match exactly by method, locationReference and windowReference.
Require the FOOD-007E selected slot revision to equal FOOD-007T slot governingRevision exactly.
Require skuArithmetic to be a dense direct-Array.prototype array with no custom, null or subclass prototype and no sparse, extra, accessor or symbol elements.
Validate every FOOD-007T SKU arithmetic entry using its exact canonical field set.
Validate every SKU governingRevision, capacityUnits, recordedHeldQuantity, recordedCapacityDelta, demandQuantity and recordedDemandAdjustedCapacityDelta.
Recheck recordedCapacityDelta = capacityUnits - recordedHeldQuantity using BigInt and signed-safe conversion.
Recheck recordedDemandAdjustedCapacityDelta = recordedCapacityDelta - demandQuantity using BigInt and signed-safe conversion.
Require every SKU demandQuantity to be a positive safe integer.
Validate FOOD-007T slot arithmetic using its exact canonical field set.
Require slot demandQuantity to equal exactly 1.
Recheck slot recordedCapacityDelta = capacityUnits - recordedHeldQuantity.
Recheck slot recordedDemandAdjustedCapacityDelta = recordedCapacityDelta - 1.
For each SKU assign admissible = recordedDemandAdjustedCapacityDelta >= 0.
For the slot assign admissible = recordedDemandAdjustedCapacityDelta >= 0.
If every SKU admission and the slot admission are true, return outcome admissible.
If any SKU admission or the slot admission is false, return outcome insufficient-capacity.
Return invalid for malformed, hostile, noncanonical, inconsistent, mismatched or numerically unsafe inputs.
Return a detached and deeply frozen result.

semanticBoundary.newMeaningIntroducedHere: FOOD-007U is the first unit in this chain that interprets the sign of FOOD-007T recordedDemandAdjustedCapacityDelta as a capacity-admission rule.
semanticBoundary.zero: Zero means the exact supplied governing-scope recorded evidence covers the full reservation demand exactly and therefore passes admission rule version 1.
semanticBoundary.positive: Positive means the exact supplied governing-scope recorded evidence exceeds the reservation demand and passes admission rule version 1.
semanticBoundary.negative: Negative means the exact supplied governing-scope recorded evidence does not cover the reservation demand and therefore yields insufficient-capacity under admission rule version 1.
semanticBoundary.aggregate: Admission is all-or-nothing across all demanded SKUs plus the selected slot.

safeClaim: An admissible FOOD-007U result means only that the supplied canonical FOOD-007E demand/source-selection context correlates exactly with the supplied canonical FOOD-007T governing-scope arithmetic and that every correlated demand-adjusted delta is nonnegative under admission policy version 1. An insufficient-capacity result means at least one exactly correlated supplied delta is negative.
authorityBoundary: FOOD-007U assigns capacity-admission semantics only after strict FOOD-007E/FOOD-007T correlation. It does not mutate or persist anything and does not prove the evidence remains current at a later mutation instant. Admissible is not durable reservation success, persisted hold, checkout acceptance, write permission or fulfillment authority.
currentnessBoundary: No clock, current-source read, mutation-time reread or concurrency snapshot is performed here. The result describes only the exact canonical governing-scope evidence supplied to this pure evaluation.
concurrencyBoundary: A later authoritative writer must evaluate or re-evaluate the required governing source, commitment state and admission rule within its protected mutation boundary before relying on admission for a durable write.
mutationBoundary: No reservation parent row, SKU claim, slot claim or other durable state is inserted, updated or deleted.
acceptanceBoundary: No FoodReservationAcceptanceVersion or acceptance constructor is imported, created or returned. Acceptance remains downstream of verified successful authoritative mutation.
holdCommandBoundary: FOOD-007N remains structural hold intent. FOOD-007U does not rewrite FOOD-007N, does not mutate its command and does not claim that a previously produced hold command is still admissible.
governingPolicyBoundary: FOOD-007U consumes FOOD-007E selected revisions and canonical FOOD-007T governingRevision evidence only for exact correlation. It does not independently choose a governing revision or replace FOOD-007O governing-source policy.
physicalInventoryBoundary: No physical quantity-on-hand read, physical inventory movement or claim of physical inventory truth.

hostileInput.inheritedIteratorHooks: must not be consulted before canonical direct-array validation/capture

numericRules.demandQuantity: positive safe integer for SKU; exactly 1 for slot
numericRules.identityRecheck: Use BigInt for both capacity subtraction and demand subtraction before validating conversion to signed safe Number.
numericRules.thresholdComparison: Compare the validated signed-safe recordedDemandAdjustedCapacityDelta directly with zero. Do not recompute an alternate threshold and do not clamp.

admissible: all SKU deltas positive and slot positive
mixture of positive and zero values passes
insufficientCapacity: one negative SKU fails aggregate admission
multiple negative SKUs fail aggregate admission
negative SKU with positive slot fails
positive SKUs with negative slot fails
negative values are retained exactly rather than clamped
invalid: reservationRequest identity mismatch between FOOD-007E and FOOD-007T
fulfillmentIntent identity mismatch between FOOD-007E and FOOD-007T
hostile: inherited Symbol.iterator getter is never invoked
correlation: multiple SKUs exact correlation in canonical demand order
selected revision equals governingRevision at every SKU
selected slot revision equals slot governingRevision
request demand quantity equals arithmetic demandQuantity

correlation.requestIdentity: selectionRequest.request id/version must equal arithmetic.reservationRequest id/version.
correlation.fulfillmentIntentIdentity: selectionRequest.fulfillmentIntent id/version must equal arithmetic.fulfillmentIntent id/version.
correlation.skuCount: selectionRequest.request.capacityRequirements length, selectionRequest.skuSelections length and arithmetic.skuArithmetic length must be exactly equal.
correlation.skuOrdering: All SKU correlation is strict by canonical demand-order array index. No sorting or repair.
correlation.skuIdentity: At every index the request demand SKU, selected SKU and arithmetic SKU must have identical id/version.
correlation.slotIdentity: selectionRequest.slotSelection and arithmetic.slotArithmetic must match method, locationReference and windowReference exactly.
correlation.missingExtraRule: A missing or extra arithmetic SKU entry is objectively invalid because the independent FOOD-007E demand and selection arrays establish the required cardinality.
